cards.subject: The Founding of Durotar
lines: Both of this zone's power centres come straight out of the Warcraft III campaign. Daelin Proudmoore sailed to Kalimdor, seized Theramore and blockaded it.
Jaina judged her father's vendetta unwinnable and helped Rexxar destroy his fleet. He died in that keep. You walk into it.

cards.subject: There is nothing to do here
lines: The patch 2.3.0 note reads: "The whole zone of Dustwallow Marsh was improved to make it more quest-friendly and a less lonely place."
Everything that fixed it — Mudsprocket, the new hubs, the roads, the graveyards — is Burning Crusade.
This is the version they were apologising for.

cards.subject: Nat Pagle
cards.tag: On a spit of shore, alone
lines: The most famous fisherman in the game sits by himself in the emptiest zone in Kalimdor.
His quest sends you to catch rare fish at opposite ends of the world and carry them back to this mud.

cards.subject: Tabetha
lines: A human archmage living deep in the marsh with two apprentices, and she teaches mages of both factions.
Her class quests at thirty-eight and forty are the only reason most mages ever saw this zone.
In here there is no road to her and no graveyard. Just the shack.

cards.subject: The Shady Rest Inn
lines: A human inn burned to the ground.
In here that is the whole story. The investigation, the hoofprints and the answer all arrive with the 2.3 rebuild.
Right now it is a ruin nobody mentions.

cards.subject: How the Horde got these ogres
lines: Rexxar walked into the Stonemaul village, beat their leader to death in single combat, and handed the clan on.
Overlord Mok'Morokk holds Brackenwall as his successor.
He refuses to move against the dragons that burned their old home.

cards.subject: Stonemaul Ruins
lines: The smoking ruin south of Brackenwall is the ogres' real home. Onyxia's brood raided it and took it, and Firemane dragonspawn hold it now.
The survivors went north and built the village you buy things in.
Some of them refused to leave.

cards.subject: Rexxar does not live in this swamp
lines: He walks the road through Desolace, Feralas and Stonetalon with Misha, back and forth, and never stops.
Horde players hunting him for the Onyxia attunement lost hours to that.
The chain touches this zone. He does not.

cards.subject: Alcaz Island
lines: The island off the east coast is held by Strashaz naga at fifty-seven to sixty-two elite, in a zone built for thirty-five to forty-five.
There is an underground prison beneath it.
Almost nothing in here tells you to go.

cards.subject: Doctor Weavil
lines: The mad gnome and his machines are on Alcaz Island, and he is a step in the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.
He stole a book from Narain Soothfancy.
Opening the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj runs through an island in this swamp.

cards.subject: Emberstrife's Den
lines: The key to Upper Blackrock Spire is forged in this swamp.
You beat a black dragon down, lay the unfired seal in front of him, take his mind with an orb of draconic energy, and order him to breathe on it.
Then you leave and he is still there.

cards.subject: Lady Katrana Prestor
cards.tag: Who is at the bottom of this marsh
lines: The dragon down there also sat in Stormwind Keep as royal advisor to the throne.
She very nearly took the kingdom apart from inside before Marshal Windsor unmasked her.
Then she came back here.

cards.subject: The maw in the Wyrmbog
cards.tag: Go and stand in front of it
lines: The entrance is carved as an open mouth, and the passage behind it is magma-lined with the ground cracked and glowing.
One of the two forty-player raids the game shipped with.
It is sitting in the corner of a levelling zone most players never finished.
